working_definition: Alpha'/beta'-lobe Kenyon cells (α'/β'-KCs) of the adult mushroom body: intrinsic mushroom body neurons whose axons bifurcate to form the alpha' and beta' lobes, identified in this atlas by trio+/sNPF- expression and DAT (dopamine transporter) as a specific marker, plus elevated OxPhos gene expression/mitochondrial turnover. Required for early (acquisition/short-to-middle-term) memory consolidation. This 0-50-day adult brain atlas resolves α'/β'-KCs only at the whole-lobe level, not into finer anterior/posterior/middle subtypes.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Mushroom body neuron of the adult that bifurcates at the anterior end of the pedunculus, projecting into the mushroom body alpha'-lobe and beta'-lobe (Lee et al., 1999; Tanaka et al., 2008). It develops from a larval alpha'/beta' Kenyon cell with little alteration during metamorphosis (Lee et al., 1999). ... There is a total of around 340 of these cells per hemisphere (Li et al., 2020).

justification: The cluster's discriminating marker (trio+, sNPF-, plus DAT as a distinguishing marker per the paper's Fig S3G-H) and neuropil (alpha'/beta' lobes, adult brain) match FBbt:00049834 'adult alpha'/beta' Kenyon cell' exactly. This atlas is adult tissue and the FBbt term is explicitly the adult form (developing with little alteration from the larval alpha'/beta' KC during metamorphosis). FBbt further subdivides into anterior-posterior/middle subtypes from connectomic studies, but the report states no finer subtype resolution was achieved in this atlas (subclustering separated on technical covariates only), so the whole-lobe adult term is the correct and complete level.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Mushroom body neuron that is born during the late-larval stage... During the pupal stage, it remains largely the same and forms the alpha'/beta' lobes of the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent term spanning larval-through-adult lineage; less specific than the adult-restricted term, which is the correct level for this adult-brain atlas.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A subgroup of the adult mushroom body alpha'/beta' neurons that has dendrites in the main calyx and projects axons to the anterior and posterior layers of the alpha'/beta' lobes (connectomic classification).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Finer sub-lobe subtype from connectomic (EM) studies, not resolvable from this transcriptomic atlas per the report's subclustering analysis.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00049834 'adult alpha'/beta' Kenyon cell' as an exact match at the correct (whole-lobe) resolution level supported by the data.
